summary: Worthington Steel filed an 8-K detailing financing for its voluntary public cash takeover of Klöckner Co SE via BidCo at €11.00/share. The registrant completed a $700M 7.750% senior secured notes offering due 2033, a Term Loan Facility, and a Revolving Facility Amendment to fund the acquisition consideration, repay existing debt, and pay fees. The offer is for all outstanding shares of Klöckner, with closing expected on June 3, 2026. The notes are unregistered senior secured obligations. The transaction represents a cross-border public tender; regulatory and financing conditions have been satisfied, with completion imminent.
